, (right) Elite Prized Gladiator's Chain Armor]] Elite Gladiator gear (or just elite gear) refers to the highest‑tier PvP armor and weapons available during a given PvP season, available for purchase by players who achieved the required rating in rated Arenas or Rated Battlegrounds. Introduced in as weapons and expanded to include armor in , elite gear offered the season's top PvP item levels and stats, making it the best equipment available for competitive PvP at the time. Since , elite gear exists only as transmog and offers no PvP stats.

The Elven House of Scribes is an elven organization of scribes affiliated to the kingdom of Quel'Thalas.
